objective: Implement verified relink and batch aspect/export variants
flags: none new; relink writes are project edits (undoable); batch exports use the existing render queue
deviations: Relink replaces a medium by another already imported into the project (hashed and probed); no client path, no in-place replacement of an object

Relink compatibility: same kind, enough source for every clip (speed included), sound where a clip plays it; differences (bytes, name, size, aspect, duration, sound) are shown before approval; color tags are not compared (documented)
Apply recomputes the hash-named proposal at the head; the internal asset.relink operation is refused by the generic applyBatch
Provenance lives in a new asset_replacements table (workspace schema 15), written once per apply; redo/restore write none (documented)
Export variants change only the output size (same contain fit); a batch is up to 4 variants, admitted together, and COMPLETED only when every output is
